name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Open-Face Roast Beef Sandwich with Brown Gravy
whyItWorks: Tender slow-braised sliced roast beef served over soft white bread with smooth mashed Idaho potatoes and savory brown gravy. Soothing and easy to break down.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Roast Beef Sandwich with mashed potatoes and brown gravy.
